issue.title: Five 🔖 same-note [[#^h-…|🔖]] backlinks dangle after their tasks moved out of ref/docs/sase_AGENTS_v2

task_type_fields.impact: 4 of the 17 live `🔖` follow-up tasks (about a quarter) cannot jump back to their highlight today. The proposed ⌘↵ → Highlights page jump (research:202611/highlights_annotation_page_jump/highlights_annotation_page_jump__final.md §3.3) also needs a unique-ID fallback to work on them until the links are fixed.
task_type_fields.repro:
Five `🔖` annotation-backlink task lines in the vault use the same-note form `[[#^h-<id>|🔖]]`, but the tasks now live outside the ref note that holds the block, so clicking `🔖` (and any resolver that follows the link literally) goes nowhere. Each ID exists exactly once, in `ref/docs/sase_AGENTS_v2.md`:

- `sase_memory.md`: `h-ba8aa1d90d3a`, `h-ae83d7bbfe11`
- `sase.md`: `h-8bacd7168c2b`
- `done/sase_memory_done.md`: `h-70d365644b02`
- `_conflicts/sase.kellys-mbp-2026-10-23T224729-0400.md`: `h-8bacd7168c2b` (conflict copy)

Reproduce on apollo:

```bash
cd ~/bob && grep -n '\[\[#\^h-[0-9a-f]*|🔖\]\]' sase_memory.md sase.md done/sase_memory_done.md
grep -rl '^\^h-ba8aa1d90d3a\s*$' ref ref_history   # -> ref/docs/sase_AGENTS_v2.md only
```

Root cause: the tasks were moved out of the ref note by hand (vault commit `3837af6f6`, 2026-08-29). That predates `bob task move`'s same-note link qualification (covered by `src/native/task_move/tests.rs::repairs_every_required_link_form_across_note_kinds`), so the relative links were never rewritten. Expected remediation: qualify them to `[[ref/docs/sase_AGENTS_v2#^h-<id>|🔖]]`. Decide whether a `bob ref doctor`-style check that detects (and optionally repairs) same-note `#^h-` backlinks whose block is missing from their own note is worth adding so this cannot recur silently.

issue.creation_reason: Found while counting where 🔖 backlinks point for the Highlights page-jump research: a quarter of the live annotation follow-ups cannot reach their highlight, and nothing reports it.
